messages:
Maya Patel: Quick idea — run a 20m 'mini-sprint' rehearsal focused on the embed demo flow (short talk + live embed probe) before the main webinar. Keep it tight: 7m talk, 7m live demo, 6m q&a. Thoughts?
Ashwin Rao: Love it. Need to confirm speaker bandwidth. Who's volunteering for the live embed probe?
Maya Patel: Samir? you flagged interest last week re: cost/perf slide.
Samir Chen: I can do the live probe but prefer using a canned dataset + proxy so we don't hit prod quota during rehearsal.
Jordan Lee: Agree with proxy. Ops: can we spin a small dedicated instance with limited keys for the run? Just a single model variant and a cached prefix.
OpsBot: @Jordan Lee Provisional sandbox cluster (dedicated-small) available for 1749917400 rehearsal window. Rate limits: 50 req/min, token cap 20k.
Camille Ortiz: Schedule wise I can join any 9am–12pm PT slot next week. Which day?
Maya Patel: How about Wed 9:30am PT — gives us time to patch slides. Samir, can you craft a 90s script and a fallback clip in case live fails?
Samir Chen: Yes. I'll produce a 90s demo script + a 60s recorded fallback clip. Will mock the embed vector DB queries with canned responses.
Ashwin Rao: For messaging, aim to surface three metrics: end-to-end latency, tokens/call cost, and retrieval precision. Keep numbers rounded.
Maya Patel: Agreed. Jordan, can you and Ops confirm network egress and CORS for the demo page? We don't want blocked iframe issues.
Jordan Lee: We'll host a static demo page on staging-cdn.redwood.internal and use a proxy route /demo-embed that rewrites Authorization header. I'll add CSP + CORS allowlist for staging.
Camille Ortiz: I'll prep the speaker mic cues and slide handoff notes. Suggest this order: intro (Maya) -> tech context (Ashwin) -> demo (Samir) -> Q&A (panel).
Maya Patel: Nice. Can we get a micro-timing sheet? 7/7/6 split isn't enough detail for transitions.
Samir Chen: Draft micro-timing below:
```
00:00–01:30 — Maya intro + outcomes
01:30–04:00 — Ashwin cost/latency snapshot (2 charts)
04:00–04:30 — slide handoff
04:30–11:00 — Samir live demo (prep, show query, show embed results)
11:00–11:30 — fallback clip queued if live fails
11:30–14:00 — panel Q&A first tranche
14:00–14:30 — closing + CTA (signup/whitepaper)
```
Jordan Lee: Ops checklist for demo run:
- Prewarm model KV cache (run 3 warmup calls)
- Ensure sandbox API key has rate cap 50rpm
- Caching: enable prefix cache for demo prompt
- Fallback video pre-uploaded to staging-cdn
Camille Ortiz: I'll run the prewarm commands during the green room and confirm.
Maya Patel: Samir, for the embed probe content — keep language simple: ask a product question + an edge-case long prompt. We want to show retrieval quality and the effect of quantization/latency tradeoffs.
Samir Chen: Cool. I'll create two prompts: one short QA (fast-path) and one long context probe (cache benefits visible). Also include a quick note on expected token cost.
Ashwin Rao: Can you add an annotation line for the slide: "expected latency (p50/p95) + expected token cost per call". Keep numbers conservative + include margin.
Samir Chen: Will do. Example numbers: p50 120ms, p95 420ms (sandbox); cost ~ $0.002 per call (rounded). I'll footnote that production numbers vary.
Maya Patel: Communication plan for attendees: 1) short tweet thread day-of, 2) two CTAs in slide deck (signup + benchmark report), 3) follow-up email with recording + slide + code snippet. Camille can you draft the email?
Camille Ortiz: On it. Will draft and share in #marketing-drafts by EOD Monday.
Jordan Lee: Small tech ask — Samir can you include the exact curl we use for the proxy so I can test headers? Example below is fine to adapt:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.internal/demo-embed \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sandbox_key' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"Find product specs for model X, include price ranges"}'
```
Samir Chen: That matches. I'll add the exact prompt payload and sample response.
Maya Patel: Rehearsal roles: Maya host + timekeeper, Ashwin slides + metrics, Samir demo engineer, Jordan ops + cut to fallback, Camille comms. OpsBot to post countdown 10/5 minutes.
OpsBot: Reminder set — rehearsal Wed 1749917400 09:30 PT. Auto-post: 10m and 5m countdown to #marketing.
Ashwin Rao: One more ask — can we capture token-level cost in the demo console so attendees see the economics? Maybe a tiny overlay that increments after each call.
Jordan Lee: We can add a simple client-side overlay that reads the response header X-Token-Cost and aggregates. I'll instrument the proxy to include that header for staging.
Samir Chen: Great. I'll emit X-Token-Cost in the sandbox responses. Format like: X-Token-Cost: 0.0019
Maya Patel: Perfect. Let's sync on slide deck by EOD Tue. If no blockers, rehearsal is a go. :thumbsup:
Camille Ortiz: +1 — sending draft email tonight.
Samir Chen: Uploading fallback clip to staging-cdn now.
Jordan Lee: Will run prewarm + test proxy traffic tomorrow morning.
Maya Patel: Thanks team — see you in green room Wed.
